text:
maya: forwarding a customer report — free-tier credits are showing in org dashboard but invoices still show full charge. customer says credits were granted yesterday and then used today; balance shows correctly in UI though invoice line item is full amount. attaching logs next.

jordan-billing: thanks, can you paste org_id and sample invoice id? I want to check if the promo was attached to usage records or just to the account ledger.

maya: org_id: org_01G7abcdEF, invoice: inv_2026_03_02_317. Customer timeline: granted promo 'SPRINGFREE-50' at 2026-03-01T22:15Z, then multiple /v1/generate calls on 2026-03-02 03:10-03:35Z (approx).

jordan-billing: looking. Quick check: ledger shows credit grant on 2026-03-01T22:15Z for 50.00 USD promo credit. Invoice inv_2026_03_02_317 created 2026-03-02T04:00Z with amount_due 12.50 USD. But consumption entries show zero promo_id on usage rows.

sam-engr: that suggests the usage events weren't tagged with the promo id at ingest. Could be a race where grant and first request crosshost. Any chance the customer applied promo after first calls?

maya: customer insists promo was applied before they started sending requests — they provided screenshot of confirmation at 22:16Z (attached).

sam-engr: can we repro by simulating quick grant + immediate request? I'll run a local flow to see if our ingestion path attaches promo metadata atomically.

ops-bot: triggered job 'usage-replay' for org_01G7abcdEF (id: jr_8821).

sam-engr: repro steps I used:
1) POST /v1/promos/apply {org:org_01..., promo:SPRINGFREE-50} -> 200
2) Immediately POST /v1/generate (10 concurrent) -> all 200 responses
3) Query /v1/internal/usage?org=org_01...&since=2026-03-01T22:00Z -> usage rows returned with promo_id = null for the first ~5s window

sam-engr: SQL snippet from replica (trimmed):
```
SELECT id, created_at, tokens, promo_id, metadata->>'applied_by' as applied_by
FROM usage_events
WHERE org_id = 'org_01G7abcdEF' AND created_at >= '2026-03-01T22:15:00Z'
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 20;
```

sam-engr: sample rows:
```
-- row 1: id=ue_9001, created_at=2026-03-01T22:15:02Z, tokens=120, promo_id=NULL
-- row 2: id=ue_9002, created_at=2026-03-01T22:15:03Z, tokens=45, promo_id='SPRINGFREE-50'
-- row 3: id=ue_9003, created_at=2026-03-01T22:15:05Z, tokens=80, promo_id='SPRINGFREE-50'
```

jordan-billing: aha, that pattern shows a small window where the grant hasn't fully propagated to the usage pipeline. In billing rules we prioritize assigned credits first, but if usage row has promo_id NULL it won't auto-consume promo ledger entries. That explains invoice mismatch.

maya: customer wants to know if their money will be refunded or if we can apply promo retroactively.

jordan-billing: we can run a backfill that scans for usage rows in the grant window and set promo_id where appropriate, then re-run invoice calculation for inv_2026_03_02_317. Policy: we only backfill within first 7 days of grant and if the grant owner equals org owner; customer's case qualifies. I'll queue manual backfill and notify finance for invoice reissue.

sam-engr: short-term mitigation: add a tiny 2s wait after promo apply to ensure propagation, or make promo apply synchronous to the ingestion topic (longer term). I'll file ENG-1359 for a fix to make promo metadata atomic in the write path.

maya: creating support ticket with customer update: will run backfill and follow up in ~2h.

billing-bot: backfill job queued: backfill_2026_03_02_org_01G7abcdEF (ETA ~45m).

jordan-billing: also checking expiration edge cases — promo SPRINGFREE-50 expires 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z UTC, so not relevant here. But callout: if promo was created in a different timezone or applied via UI vs API there are small codepaths where metadata propagation differs. We'll audit.

sam-engr: created ENG-1359 and linked to support ticket. Temporary workaround documented in internal runbook: after applying a promo, run `GET /v1/promos/status?org=...` and wait for state = "active" before heavy traffic.

maya: customer updated: "thanks, please reissue invoice" — I'll confirm once finance reissues. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: backfill_2026_03_02_org_01G7abcdEF completed successfully. 12 usage rows patched, total promo consumed: 12.50 USD.

jordan-billing: invoice reissued as inv_2026_03_02_317_v2, amount_due 0.00 USD. Customer notified.

sam-engr: leaving a note: we hit a classic eventual-consistency window between promo-grant and usage ingestion. Fix will remove the manual step.

maya: closing loop with customer, marking ticket resolved. :white_check_mark:
